in_marathi.name: Sharvanik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Spring, Freshness, Youth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvanik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvanik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva' which means 'spring'. This name is a perfect representation of the new beginnings and fresh starts that come with the arrival of spring. It is also symbolic of youth, vitality, and renewal.
